messages.text: I can see the Trail running shoes in your delivered order, but the shop’s records don’t show that they’ve been received back yet. They must arrive back before a refund can be requested (refund-policy/v2/return). If you’ve already sent them, let me know; if you’ll send them later, please wait until they arrive.
